ios.desc:
BUILD AI APPS. TRAIN AGENTS. AUTOMATE EVERYTHING.

Taskade is an AI App Builder and Agent Platform that transforms your ideas into living software.

Meet Taskade Genesis.

Describe what you need in one sentence and Taskade instantly generates a fully working app with structured data, AI agents, automation, and real-time collaboration built in.

One prompt. One app. No code required.

TURN IDEAS INTO SYSTEMS THAT RUN

With Taskade Genesis, you do not generate files. You generate live applications.

Create:
- Dashboards and analytics tools
- Client portals and internal team hubs
- CRM systems with lead scoring and follow-ups
- Booking systems and scheduling tools
- Forms, calculators, and approval workflows
- Knowledge bases and project command centers
- Custom internal tools for any team

Just describe your idea:
"A CRM with lead scoring and automated emails"
"A client portal with booking and invoicing"
"A marketing dashboard that updates weekly"

Taskade builds the interface, database, AI agents, and workflows already connected and ready to use.

Publish instantly with a secure link.
Add password protection or connect your own domain.
Clone and remix community-built apps in one click.

IMPORTANT FOR EXISTING USERS

Taskade still works exactly as before.

If you prefer using Taskade as a fast, simple task and project manager, nothing has been removed.

Your lists are not going away.
Your workflows still function.
AI features are optional.
Genesis is optional.

You can continue using Taskade for tasks, notes, and collaboration without AI in your way.

Two paths. One workspace. You choose.

AI AGENTS - BUILD, TRAIN, DEPLOY

Create intelligent AI agents that think, learn, and act 24 hours a day.

Assign roles such as:
- Analyst
- Researcher
- Sales Assistant
- Support Representative
- Content Writer
- Operations Manager
- Project Coordinator

Train agents on:
- PDFs, documents, spreadsheets, and presentations
- Web links and live resources
- Workspace projects and structured data
- Your past conversations and ongoing updates

Run multiple agents together to brainstorm, analyze, review, and execute complex work.

Choose leading AI models including GPT, Claude, and Gemini.

Agents remember context and collaborate with your team in real time.

AUTOMATION - WORK THAT RUNS ITSELF

Build powerful workflows without writing code.

- Trigger automations from forms, schedules, emails, webhooks, or app events
- Let AI categorize, prioritize, and route tasks
- Automate on

android.desc: Introducing Taskade Genesis, the origin of living software. Your workspace now remembers, learns, and builds with you. Projects hold memory. AI Agents think and reason. Automations move with purpose. One prompt, one app — born from your Workspace DNA. Together they form the trinity of memory, intelligence, and creation. IMAGINE IT. RUN IT LIVE. From a single thought, a live app begins to form. Taskade Genesis designs, connects, and brings it to life. No code. No setup. Just your imagination turning into action YOUR WORKSPACE DNA Everything you've built — your Projects, AI Agents, and Automations — becomes the core intelligence that powers your apps. Genesis adapts to your process and builds from within your workspace. YOUR SECOND BRAIN FULLY ALIVE Open Taskade. Describe your idea. Watch it come to life. This is where memory turns into motion, where intelligence awakens through creation, and your Taskade workspace begins to dream with you. GET IN TOUCH We value your feedback.
